title: C: Plugin System (Simulated)
description: Simulate a plugin system where plugins register operations via a central registry using function pointers.

steps.title: Plugin Registry
steps.description: Define a `Plugin` struct with name, version, and an `execute` function pointer. Create a registry that stores up to 10 plugins. Write `void register_plugin(Plugin *p)` and `void run_plugin(char *name)`. Create 2 plugins: 'math' (adds 5+3) and 'print' (prints a message).
hints: Run: find by name and call execute.

verification.failureMessage: Run both math and print plugins
